postChoisi.texteOriginal:
One of the best business hacks is being your own biggest cheerleader.

Trust me, you're going to need it.

When you're just starting out, very few people will believe in you.

Maybe your spouse.
Maybe your friends.
Maybe your family.

Maybe.

So you better believe in yourself enough for all of them.

Talk confidently.
Toot your own horn.
Wear your own merch.
Celebrate the wins nobody else cares about.

You might feel a little ridiculous.

Good.

Because one day, if things work out, something funny happens:

Everyone who doubted you suddenly remembers being incredibly supportive.

"I always knew."
"I could see it coming!"

Sure.

The most important part of self-belief is that it keeps you in the game long enough to get good.

Then you *actually* have to get good.

It took me a decade to figure those things out while building my one-person business to $15M in profit.

I broke down everything I learned in a free 30-page guide to solopreneurship.

Hundreds of articles, hours of voice notes, and interviews with successful builders compressed into something you can read in 30 minutes.

Free here: https://buff.ly/aDit80i
